relevance_note: Evidence review whose Table 1 gives individual-level ages at diagnosis and developmental outcomes for previously published GAMT deficiency patients and their siblings ("Studies Comparing GAMT Deficiency Treatment Before 6 Months of Age").
method_note: Evidence review / newborn-screening recommendation. The only individual-level data are in Table 1, which summarizes previously published patients: each data row gives one infant treated before 6 months (columns 'Treatment Onset Aged <6 Mo') and, except row 6 (Viau et al, 2013; '—, no sibling comparator'), an older sibling with later treatment (columns 'Sibling With Later Treatment'). Table 1 has no label column, so infants are 'Table 1 row k' (k = data rows 1-9, after the two header rows) and siblings 'older sibling of Table 1 row k' (column heading 'Age of Older Sibling at Diagnosis'; sex not stated). The 'Source' cell is copied into source_reference_in_review. A Python script in my scratch directory transcribed the table rows into cells; I checked its output against the table, and every span was verified verbatim against the paper. 'Age of Diagnosis and Treatment' / 'Age of Older Sibling at Diagnosis' are recorded as age at diagnosis; 'Prenatal' and 'Birth' get no ISO value. 'Duration of Treatment and Follow-up' is a duration, not an age, so it is put in treatment_summary and age at last evaluation is left not reported. A 'Normal' developmental outcome is recorded (D-27) as developmental delay excluded and the composite checklist item 'developmental delay or intellectual disability' excluded. Sibling outcomes stated as improvement ('improved motor skills, started walking, improved tone') were not recorded as features, except 'improved autistic features' (recorded as autistic features observed, detail improved). Speech delay was not mapped to the checklist item 'absent or limited speech'; 'speaks "a few words"' was. No GAMT variants are printed for anyone, so the variants table is empty. Contradictions / possible duplicates: Table 1 rows 1 (El-Gharbawy et al, 2013) and 2 (Dhar et al, 2009) carry identical values for both infant and sibling and may be the same family reported twice; the text says 'Six studies describing 8 infants' while Table 1 has 9 infant rows. People were not merged. Dhar et al, 2009 also supplies row 7. Group-level mentions (22-subject study, 5 referred patients, single screen-detected cases in Australia, Utah and New York, 'Over 50 cases') give no individual-level detail and get no rows; n_patients_reported and cohort_size_as_stated are null because the authors state no total for the people described. prior_report_citation is left not reported because the sources differ per person and are recorded per individual.

study_type.span: This report summarizes the key elements leading to this recommendation.

cites_prior_report_of_same_patients.span: Six studies describing 8 infants were identified by the evidence review in which treatment was started before 6 months of age.
